scope.implemented: COM-stable native combined GPU source publication: compare relative layouts against the retained catalogue, correct observed body poses into the original publication frame, preserve interpolation histories across common translations and label/contact-only changes
scope.unchanged: authoritative physics, wire v9, bounded catalogue policy, existing GPU device/queue/opaque pass/scene targets, resolved graphics enable and quality policy
scope.not_implemented: network payload/pose separation or mesh dictionary, general incremental GPU residency, custom PRIMARY identity/geometry, full authored designs/materials, prediction/reconciliation, complete Bevy replacement
scope.licensing: implementation stays in the GPL native game application; no engine dependencies, unsafe code or external packages added

contracts.publication: retain the catalogue Arc that produced GPU buffers, not each latest revision; equality checks IDs, part counts, relative origins, exact orientations and mesh positions/normals/indices; Arc identity is an early-out, not a required identity
contracts.storage_cost: one bounded decoded catalogue Arc can keep an older contact/appearance payload alive alongside the observer's latest catalogue; no deep payload clone or unbounded revision cache
contracts.pose: publication_root_position = observed_body_position + body_rotation * (current_first_part_origin - published_first_part_origin); mesh vertices stay in the original publication's body frame
contracts.interpolation: existing inertial endpoint linear interpolation and attitude slerp at PRIMARY's render epoch; the first part identifies COM translation but is not the interpolated origin; true source/layout changes reset histories
contracts.precision: relative origins differ by at most 1e-9 m against the retained publication; narrowing reserves this inside the existing 1e-3 m local vertex budget and culling radii include the allowance; repeated packet changes cannot accumulate tolerance drift
contracts.freshness: mismatched catalogue/snapshot revisions withhold draws and do not consume poses under a wrong frame; stale data and unbracketed clocks still withhold; explicit empty membership retires source/history
contracts.rebuild: membership, relative part pose, vertex, normal, index or availability changes retain the existing complete combined-source replacement path, including PRIMARY reupload
contracts.network_gap: COM changes still revise and transmit the complete contact/appearance catalogue, including unchanged vertex/index buffers
contracts.disabled: no fleet GPU source, retained publication or interpolation track work when resolved fleet rendering is disabled
